question: How much extra area is required for the same-dose geometry to pass across declared transport scenarios, rather than only under the favorable nominal assumptions?
preserved_primary: Original H1, original model_specification.json, numerical_primary.json and accepted nominal result are unchanged.

geometry.density_rule: 420000 divided by original seven-annulus volume; preserved at all h
geometry.segmentation: minimum number of pouches of length<=70mm; full segments and one remainder, actual end effects volume weighted

source.temporal: constant increment maintained to each15/30/60min deadline

scenarios.interpretation: 24 explicitly assumed discrete scenarios. No probabilities, confidence coverage, or guaranteed continuous ranges. Finite outer Robin resistance replaces outer perfect sink only; inner wall remains reflecting.

outputs.map: all h*D*P*ends with conditional eta, tail bounds, area/length/payload/footprint
outputs.set_frontier: minimum eta across each discrete set by h
outputs.selection: smallest lateral area with lower numerical estimate meeting target for every set member; demonstrate every lower-area competitor has at least one upper estimate below target or mark unresolved

numerics.primary: continuum Neumann-inner/Robin-outer Bessel eigenfunctions and axial absorbing sine modes or zero reflecting mode
numerics.independent: existing conservative FV radial/axial operator including face Robin conductance
checks: radial quadrature128 modes at1024points representative Robin cases
FV160/560 and320/1120 at representative and selected-worst/adjacent cases
refine any threshold interval overlap before classifying
numerics.reported_uncertainty: analytic truncation bound plus explicit floating-point guard; empirical independent FV differences separately reported; not certified enclosure

monotonicity: No continuous D or P monotonicity is assumed for selection. Every discrete combination is evaluated; observed ordering is diagnostic only. The simple D-clock proof for perfect sinks is not reused with fixed finite P.

reviewer_reproduction.critical_D_at_h0p6: solve eta30=.8 under favorable sinks with dose-preserved segmentation
reviewer_reproduction.waveform: compare uniformly distributed instantaneous initial inventory delivered by30min against constant production over30min at baseline; use separate denominators and state these are different inputs
